nextChange: Read-only final audit and recommendations; no implementation change requested.

sources.summary: Owner-approved single reader queue with save/find/mark-read success; accounts, sharing and recommendations excluded.
Local Node application, JSON persistence, queue state ownership and public presentation boundary.
Read articles remain in the queue; mark-read preserves title/address.
Installed inventory found only design, vision and glossary; inspect reports no manifests and a clean tree.
Exactly three tracked documents; no implementation or checks.

findings.problem: The approved save/list/mark-read journey has no implementation or executable protection. This is a documented starting state, not an observed regression.
findings.principle: Deliver the approved queue journey through queue-owned operations; preserve article title and address and retain read articles.
findings.consequence: There is no runnable product and no evidence that the approved success outcome works or survives persistence.
findings.fix: Implement the smallest local Node journey with JSON persistence through the queue boundary. Add one public integration journey: save title/address, list the saved article, mark read, list again and reopen storage to confirm the same title/address and read status remain. Keep presentation behind the public operations.
findings.verification: Run the public journey with disposable JSON storage; assert outcomes from VISION.md:5, DESIGN.md:3-6 and glossary.md:4-5, including persistence across reopening. Review presentation for direct storage writes. Do not assert private helper structure.

findings.problem: DESIGN.md defines behaviour and boundaries but does not state what execution evidence completes a change. No maintained check command exists.
findings.principle: Proposed review policy: completion requires affected public journeys to pass on final inputs with expectations traced to approved sources.
findings.consequence: Future work could be called complete based on unit tests while the save/find/mark-read outcome remains unverified.
findings.fix: Propose a short completion-evidence section in DESIGN.md linking the approved acceptance sources and the eventual public journey check. Document one repo-owned native check command once it exists; passing unit tests alone does not establish the journey.
findings.verification: Review the section against VISION.md:5 and the existing queue boundary; run the documented command on final inputs and retain exit/output with public journey coverage.

limitations: Product readiness is verification blocked: no application or native journey/check command exists; no run-checks plan can execute product behaviour.
All findings are proposals; no changes selected, no project edits or audit record applied.
Main-thread research chosen because only three short files make delegation wasteful; subagents and web available but unused.
Language and external-service research not undertaken: no native configs or service boundary to assess; no language-specific tooling recommendations made.
Measure ran over the two available commits; signals are advisory and documentation-only.
Overlap not run: no two declared change plans exist.
Router, akashic and no-mistakes were verified unavailable; no delivery service or other skill used.
Reviewed scope covers the existing documents only; future implementation paths require a separate exact reviewed scope before any edits.
